topic: Gross margin vs markup: ek hi ₹100 ka farq kis base par percentage banta hai?
caption:
₹400 ki direct cost, ₹500 selling price. Gross profit = ₹100. 👇

Gross margin = ₹100 ÷ ₹500 selling price = 20%.
Markup = ₹100 ÷ ₹400 cost = 25%.

Dono percentages ek hi example se nikle, bas denominator alag hai. Gross profit yahan overheads se pehle ka hai; example simplified hai. Pricing compare karte waqt hamesha dekho percentage kis base par calculate hua.

Aap apne product ka margin ya markup kaise track karte ho?

scenes.narration: Maan lo ek cake banane ki direct cost chaar sau rupaye hai, aur aap use paanch sau rupaye mein bechte ho. Ye simplified example hai; rent jaise overheads abhi alag rakhe hain.

scenes.narration: Gross margin mein wahi sau rupaye, selling price paanch sau se divide hote hain. Sau divide paanch sau barabar bees percent gross margin.
